result.summary: FAIL on one narrow, mechanical defect (D1) plus one labelling gap (D2); everything else from rounds 4 and SEC round 2 is fixed in place. D1: the PR (a) mix task exit rule uses report key gate_blocked_total, but 17.2 says the extra report fields ship in PR (b), so PR (a) references a PR (b) component and is ambiguous to build. D2: T-63 (and the PR split of T-43..T-52, T-58, T-59) is not explicitly assigned to PR (b). Both are one-sentence design edits; ELIXIR-DEV can already build the rest of PR (a).

findings.where: 17.2 'Stamp additions' (line 748-751) versus 17.2 'Stamp entry-point mapping' (line 753) and 13 row (a)
findings.problem: The PR (a) mix task is specified to halt 1 'when failed_total > 0 or gate_blocked_total > 0', and print_tenant prints 'the two new statuses and prerequisites_missing'. But 17.2 says 'the prerequisites, the active-row compatibility change and the extra report fields ship in PR (b)', and gate_blocked_total is one of those report fields (it also counts :snapshot_prerequisite_missing, a PR (b) status). PR (a) therefore references a PR (b) component and the build is ambiguous.
findings.required_change: State in 17.2 that in PR (a) the Stamp report gains gate_blocked_total (counting only tenant status :snapshot_not_complete) and the tenant status :snapshot_not_complete, and that the mix task and print_tenant in PR (a) use exactly those; PR (b) adds :snapshot_prerequisite_missing, prerequisites_missing, and extends gate_blocked_total to count it. Then fix the sentence 'the extra report fields ship in PR (b)' to list only prerequisites_missing and the second status.
